source: Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA), Occupational Wages Survey, via PSA OpenSTAT
population: Time-rated workers on full-time basis in the establishments PSA surveyed. Government agencies, public schools and public hospitals are not covered.

definitions.basicPay: Pay for normal working time before employees' SSS, PhilHealth and Pag-IBIG contributions and withholding tax. Excludes overtime, night shift differential and other premium pay, commissions, tips, service charges and payment in kind.
definitions.allowance: Regular, guaranteed cash payments such as living allowance. Excludes reimbursements for business expenses, uniforms, bonuses and gratuities, and family allowances.
definitions.wageRate: Basic pay plus regular, guaranteed cash allowances.
definitions.median: The amount where half of the workers receive more and half receive less.

surveys.label: 2024 Occupational Wages Survey
surveys.coverage: Establishments with 10 or more workers in all major industries
notes: The 2024 round covers establishments with 10 or more workers across all major industries; earlier rounds covered only establishments with 20 or more workers in selected industries, so the series has a break and the rounds are not directly comparable.
Sulu province is counted under BARMM. Provinces of the Negros Island Region are still counted under Regions VI and VII.

surveys.label: 2022 Occupational Wages Survey
surveys.coverage: Establishments with 20 or more workers in selected industries
notes: Earlier survey design: not directly comparable with the 2024 round.
